relations.justification: Water is the shorter-horizon constraint in a survival setting and conditions what medical care is even possible.
Traditional food preservation exemplifies applied preservative chemistry worked out empirically long before the mechanism was known.
Navigation requires topographic representation; terrain reading is what turns a bearing into a route.
A preparedness plan becomes usable through rehearsed checklists; an unexercised plan is a document, not a capability.
Effective response requires a rehearsed plan; improvisation under acute stress reliably underperforms preparation.
The acute stress response is a worked case of cognitive load degrading judgement under time pressure.
Psychological first aid requires understanding the acute stress response it is responding to, including which interventions make it worse.
